title: dep-scan mcp propose_triage output
description: The document the propose_triage tool returns: the proposal as it now stands in the decisions file, with the computed status a proposal carries.

decisionsFile.description: The decisions file the proposal was written into, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform.

result.description: proposed added a new proposal; updated rewrote an existing proposal with the same selector.

index.description: The proposal's 1-based position among the triage decisions, the handle depscan triage review takes.

state.description: The proposed CycloneDX impact analysis state.

status.description: A written proposal reads proposal; it changes nothing until a person approves it.

proposedBy.description: Who proposed, as the call named it.

entry.description: The proposal as the decisions file now holds it.
